{{Quote|This is Echo Station 5-7! Where's our air support?!''"''<br />''"''Echo Station 5-7. We're on our way!|A Rebel and Luke Skywalker during the Battle of Hoth|<ref name="Entrenched">{{StoryCite|story=Entrenched|book=Star Wars: Visionaries}}</ref>}}
'''Echo Station 5-7''' was a [[Scout/Legends|scout]] post that was situated at the perimeter of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance's]] [[Echo Base/Legends|Echo Base]], located on the ice-[[Planet/Legends|world]] of [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]]. [[Corporal/Legends|Corporal]] [[Jobin]] and his men manned this post during the [[Battle of Hoth/Legends|rearguard action]] that was meant to stall the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Imperial Army/Legends|Army]] long enough for the Rebellion to evacuate the base. The post was eventually overrun by [[All Terrain Armored Transport/Legends|All Terrain Armored Transports]] and [[HAVw A5 Juggernaut|A5 Juggernauts]], but not before Jobin took a squad back to the Rebels' [[V-150 Planet Defender/Legends|planetary ion cannon]] in order to prevent its capture by Imperial forces.<ref name="Entrenched" /> Echo Station 5-7 was also the site of three airbases and docked [[GR-75 medium transport/Legends|evacuation shuttles]]. The airbases were destroyed by the advancing Imperial forces at the order of [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]].<ref name="SW:GB">''[[Star Wars: Galactic Battlegrounds]]''</ref> Rogue Squadron was supposed to supply aerial support, but they ultimately weren't able to arrive on time.

==Behind the scenes==
Echo Station 5-7 first appeared in [[Star Wars: Episode V The Empire Strikes Back|''Star Wars'': Episode V ''The Empire Strikes Back'']]. It had a subsequent appearance in the [[2001]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: Galactic Battlegrounds]]'' during the Battle of Hoth mission in the Darth Vader campaign. It also featured in ''[[Entrenched]]'', a comic in [[2005]] ''[[Star Wars: Visionaries]]'', a collection of stories written by the concept artists of [[Star Wars: Episode III Revenge of the Sith|''Star Wars'': Episode III ''Revenge of the Sith'']]''.
